events.title: Configuration Comparison
events.restatement: Compare the 'before' and 'after' objects in config.json and output a JSON file with only the top-level keys that differ, sorted alphabetically.

events.reason: A new tool is needed. FORGE will draft several programs and test them against your data.

steps.where: before.limit != after.limit or before.color != after.color or before.old != after.new

set.json_diff: map(keys_diff, k => {key: k, before: before[k], after: after[k]})

set.diffs: map(key, k => {key: k, before: before[k], after: after[k]})

set.json_diffs: map(diffs, d => {key: d.key, before: d.before, after: d.after})

english: Keep rows where “data.before” matches the pattern ({"limit":\d+,"color":"\w+","old":true}), and pull out the matched parts.
Keep rows where “data.after” matches the pattern ({"limit":\d+,"color":"\w+","new":true}), and pull out the matched parts.
Add a column “before” = json(data.before) and add a column “after” = json(data.after).
Keep rows where before.limit is not after.limit or before.color is not after.color or before.old is not after.new.
Add a column “common_keys” = filter(keys, k => k in keys(after)).
Add a column “keys_diff” = filter(common_keys, k => before[k] != after[k]).
Remove repeated rows with the same keys_diff, keeping the first one.
Add a column “json_diff” = map(keys_diff, k => {key: k, before: before[k], after: after[k]}).
Turn each item of “json_diff” into its own row.
Add a column “diffs” = map(key, k => {key: k, before: before[k], after: after[k]}).
Add a column “json_diffs” = map(diffs, d => {key: d.key, before: d.before, after: d.after}).
Save changed-keys.json with columns key, before, after.
